metrics_note: MAE/RMSE are in rupees on the estimated-value scale; R^2 is computed on the same scale. These are held-out test-split figures.

cross_validation.note: Mean over all candidate models, shown for context. Per-model figures are in model_comparison.

model_selection_note: Selected 'RandomForestRegressor' by lowest cross-validated MAE. The held-out split was not used for selection.
baseline_note: The rule-based estimator and the dataset generator are INDEPENDENT. The generator does not import or reuse app/services/valuation.py, so the fallback is no longer the source of the training targets and is a genuinely separate comparator on this data. Neither its score nor the model's is evidence of real-world accuracy.
metrics_ceiling_note: All 900 target values are distinct, so no rows share an identical target and there is no degenerate group capping the fit. Values do approach per-category recovery floors, but each is jittered, so they are never identical. Residual error is dominated by the generator's deliberate unexplained-variance terms rather than by an unreachable floor.
data_disclaimer: This dataset is SYNTHETIC and is NOT real market data. It is generated by the committed generator at backend/app/scripts/generate_valuation_dataset.py using the fixed seed 20261007, and reproduces byte-for-byte from that seed. The generator imports only the Python standard library and is deliberately independent of app/services/valuation.py, so its targets are NOT produced by the rule-based formula the application falls back to. Every figure in it - half-lives, recovery values, multiplier ranges, price distributions - is a synthetic assumption chosen so the model has something learnable, not a finding about the e-waste market. Consequently the metrics below measure fit to those assumptions and MUST NOT be interpreted as real-world accuracy, market validation, or evidence of pricing quality.
disclaimer: DEVELOPMENT/DEMO MODEL. Trained on SYNTHETIC data produced by backend/app/scripts/generate_valuation_dataset.py (fixed seed 20261007), which is independent of the project's rule-based valuation formula. These metrics measure how well the model fits that generator's assumptions. They do NOT represent live or real-world market prices and must never be read as market accuracy.
